name: Koya Webb
reason: Out of scope (health rule): her own site (koyawebb.com home, About and Offerings pages, read 6 Nov 2026) presents her now as a holistic wellbeing, longevity and embodied-leadership coach; every current offering (CHBT Method, Get Loved Up Embodied Leadership Academy, leadership masterclass and immersion tour, Wellbeing Rituals book sold as reducing stress and healing emotional patterns) is framed around nervous-system regulation, burnout and 'dis-ease', and her Kripalu bio centres on reducing chronic disease through plant-based nutrition. Little would pass the strict health-claim rule and it is wellness coaching rather than spiritual teaching. Owner may want to look: she has a yoga school background and a self-love meditations download.
